messages:
Marta (PM): Heads-up — Acme wants private deployment + SOC2 by end of Q2. They insist on VPC + customer KMS and p99 < 120ms for gen. Need cross-team resourcing + scope negotiation.
Alex R (Eng): timeline? do they want embeddings + generation or full chat + tools?
Marta (PM): initial ask: generation + embeddings. Chat/tools are stretch for launch.
Sam L (Runtime): Runtime note: to hit p99 120ms we'll need model quantization + prefix caching. That affects accuracy. Will take ~3 weeks to validate.
Nina (Infra): Infra can provision a dedicated pool (4xA10g) in their VPC, but we need network peering + route tables. ETA from infra: 10 business days after requirements signed.
Kevin (Security): SOC2 plan: we need evidence of KMS integration and key handling. Also customer wants HSM option — that'll add gating. Need a consult and a gap analysis.
Jeff (SRE): Oncall impact: private customers add escalation surface. Can we limit scope of supported routes for initial canary? Prefer single model and no tool calls.
Olivia (CS): Acme has legal window — they need environment review by 6/20. If we miss, they push to next quarter.
Alex R (Eng): If we phase: Phase 1 = gen+embeds, canary in dedicated pool, no function calls. Phase 2 = chat + tools. Phase 1 reduces runtime risk.
Marta (PM): I like phased approach. Can we get a concrete runbook + rollout policy? Also what rollback criteria?
Sam L (Runtime): Rollout idea:
```yaml
rollout_policy:
  canary: 10%
  metrics:
    latency_p99: < 140ms
    error_rate: < 0.5%
    result_quality_regressions: 0.5% threshold
```
Start canary only after quantization pass and perf bench.
Nina (Infra): I'll own VPC reqs. Need contact + IP allowlist from Acme. I'll aim for ready by 6/5 if legal signs off this week.
Kevin (Security): I'll schedule a 90-min gap analysis with Acme's security on Tue. I'll need KMS specs and their compliance artifacts.
Jeff (SRE): Can we freeze incident runbook for first 48h of launch? Also schedule a burn rate review with infra on day 3.
Alex R (Eng): Dev work: quantization + KV cache tuning + perf tests. I estimate 3 engineers x 3 weeks.
Marta (PM): OK — proposal:
- Scope: Phase 1 = gen+embeds, no tools, single model variant (quantized)
- Milestones: infra ready 6/5, quantization validated 6/18, security gap analysis 6/10, canary start 6/20
- Owners: Nina (infra), Sam (runtime validation), Kevin (security), Alex (dev), Jeff (oncall)
Can everyone ack or flag conflicts?
Nina (Infra): Ack.
Sam L (Runtime): Ack. will push perf matrix today.
Kevin (Security): Ack — unless Acme can't provide KMS details by Fri.
Jeff (SRE): Ack — need a flat escalation contact list from Acme.
Olivia (CS): I'll get legal + acme contact today. pinging @AcmeSec (external) to share keys.
Alex R (Eng): One ask: is product comfortable shipping quantized only for Phase 1? There will be slight quality delta.
Marta (PM): Yes, but add an eval set check and a rollback threshold. If quality drops >0.5% on evals, abort.
Olivia (CS): noted. I'll communicate phased scope to Acme and lock their sign-off.
Marta (PM): Action items:
- Nina: VPC + networking reqs (due 6/2)
- Kevin: schedule gap analysis w/ Acme (due 5/28)
- Sam: perf/quantization bench + report (due 6/15)
- Alex: implement deployment toggle + metrics (due 6/12)
- Jeff: incident runbook draft (due 6/18)
- Olivia: legal + KMS contact (due 5/27)
(thumbsup emoji) Thanks everyone — we can reconvene Fri 10am to lock dates.
Marta (PM): Reconfirming: last_message_ts=1765000300
